# uptimekuma_notification_telegram (Resource)

Telegram notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_telegram" "example" {
  name       = "Telegram Notifications"
  bot_token  = "YOUR_BOT_TOKEN"
  chat_id    = "YOUR_CHAT_ID"
  is_active  = true
  is_default = false
}

resource "uptimekuma_notification_telegram" "with_options" {
  name                = "Telegram with Options"
  bot_token           = "YOUR_BOT_TOKEN"
  chat_id             = "YOUR_CHAT_ID"
  send_silently       = true
  protect_content     = true
  use_template        = false
  template_parse_mode = "HTML"
  is_active           = true
  is_default          = false
}

resource "uptimekuma_notification_telegram" "with_custom_server" {
  name       = "Telegram with Custom Server"
  bot_token  = "YOUR_BOT_TOKEN"
  chat_id    = "YOUR_CHAT_ID"
  server_url = "https://custom-telegram-api.example.com"
  is_active  = true
  is_default = false
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: bot_token_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change bot_token_wo_version whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_telegram" "write_only" {
  name = "Telegram with a write-only secret"

  chat_id = "YOUR_CHAT_ID"

  bot_token_wo         = "YOUR_BOT_TOKEN"
  bot_token_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `chat_id` (String) Telegram chat ID
- `name` (String) Notification name

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `bot_token` (String, Sensitive) Telegram bot token. Stored in state; use `bot_token_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `bot_token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Telegram bot token, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `bot_token`; requires `bot_token_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `bot_token_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `bot_token` until the next apply with `bot_token_wo` set removes it from state.
- `bot_token_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `bot_token_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `bot_token_wo`.
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `message_thread_id` (String) Message thread ID for topics in supergroups
- `protect_content` (Boolean) Protect content from forwarding
- `send_silently` (Boolean) Send message silently
- `server_url` (String) Telegram server URL (optional, defaults to official Telegram API)
- `template` (String) Custom message template
- `template_parse_mode` (String) Template parse mode (HTML, Markdown, MarkdownV2)
- `use_template` (Boolean) Use custom message template

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
